calculators.name: Parlay Calculator (/betting-calculators/parlay/)
inputs: Odds format toggle: American | Decimal | Fractional (existing legs re-convert on toggle)
Legs: 2 to 15, each with odds and an optional label
outputs: Combined odds (shown in the chosen format)
Combined implied win chance (product of each leg's implied chance; still includes vig, assumes independence)
formulas: American A<0: d = 1 + 100/|A| (A between -99 and +99 is invalid)
Combined decimal D = d1 * d2 * ... * dN
calculators.worked_example: Two legs at -110 each with $100: each leg is 1 + 100/110 = 1.9091, D = 1.9091^2 = 3.6446, profit = 100*2.6446 = $264.46, total back $364.46. Oddsy: has a parlay form (decimal list, combined odds, payout, implied prob) but no explicit profit line, no American/fractional entry and no 2-15 leg bounds.

calculators.name: PrizePicks EV Calculator (/betting-calculators/prizepicks-ev/)
inputs: Picks: 2 to 6, each with optional label and either fair American odds (whole, <= -100 or >= +100) or win probability (%)
Entry format: Power (all must hit) | Flex (needs 3+ picks)

Payout schedule: gross multiplier per number correct (0/n ... n/n), 0 to 1000x, up to 4 decimals; preset from Outlier DFS sheet (2-pick Power = 0x, 0x, 3x; back-solved from the page: 4-pick Power 4/4 = 10x, 4-pick Flex 4/4 = 6x and 3/4 = 1.5x; other rows are in client JS, not fetched)
Optional bankroll sizing: bankroll and share of full Kelly (e.g. 25%)
outputs: Equal probability needed per pick (break-even p if all picks share one p)
Power vs Flex comparison for the same picks (3+ picks)
Every-outcome breakdown (k correct: chance, return, net)
formulas: Pick probability from fair American: A<0: p = |A|/(|A|+100); A>0: p = 100/(A+100) (no vig removal)
Distribution of k correct (independent, different p_i): Poisson-binomial via DP: start [1]; for each pick, new[k] += old[k]*(1-p_i), new[k+1] += old[k]*p_i
Net profit for outcome k = stake * (mult_k - 1)
Expected total return = sum_k P(k) * stake * mult_k
Chance of net profit = sum of P(k) where mult_k > 1; chance of total loss = sum of P(k) where mult_k = 0
Break-even equal p: solve sum_k C(n,k) p^k (1-p)^(n-k) mult_k = 1 (numeric, e.g. bisection)
Kelly (Flex, multi-outcome): f* = argmax_f sum_k P(k) * ln(1 + f*(mult_k - 1)), f in [0,1]; stake = bankroll * f* * share; 0 when EV <= 0
calculators.worked_example: Two independent picks at 60% each, $100 Power at 3x: both hit with 0.6*0.6 = 0.36, which nets +$200; the other 0.64 loses $100. EV = 0.36*200 - 0.64*100 = +$8 (8% ROI), 64% chance of losing everything. Kelly = (0.36*3 - 1)/(3 - 1) = 4%; quarter Kelly on $1,000 = $10. Cross-check: picks -153/-125/-125/-125 give Power 10x ROI 3.69% and Flex 6x/1.5x ROI 9.71%. Oddsy: nothing for DFS pick'em.

calculators.name: Round Robin Calculator (/betting-calculators/round-robin/)
inputs: Exact parlay size r (2 to n)
Per leg: odds and result (Win | Loss | Push/void | Pending)
outputs: Simulated net profit (hidden while any combination is pending)
Table: every combination with stake, decimal odds, result, payout
formulas: Total stake = C(n, r) * stake per combination
Combination with any Loss leg: payout 0
Combination with no Loss and no Pending: payout = stake * product of decimal odds of non-push legs
All legs pushed: payout = stake (refund); one surviving winning leg pays at its single odds
Any Pending leg (and no Loss): combination counted as pending, not a loss
Max payout = sum over all combinations of stake * product(d_i)
Net profit = settled payout - total stake
calculators.worked_example: Five legs at +100 (2.00), every 4-leg parlay, $1 each: C(5,4) = 5 bets, $5 at risk; each parlay is 2^4 = 16.00 so pays $16; all winning returns 5*16 = $80, profit $75. Ten picks by 3s would be C(10,3) = 120 bets. Oddsy: no round robin.

calculators.name: Expected Value Calculator (/betting-calculators/expected-value/)
inputs: Fair probability input mode: Win probability (%) | Fair odds
outputs: Sensitivity table: win estimate -5, -2, 0, +2, +5 pp with $EV and EV%
formulas: Profit if won = stake * (d - 1); payout = stake * d
calculators.worked_example: $100 at +110 (d = 2.10) with a 50% estimate: win nets $110, loss costs $100, EV = 0.5*110 - 0.5*100 = +$5 (5%); break-even 1/2.10 = 47.62%, edge +2.38 pp, +$500 per 100 bets. Table: 45% -> -$5.50, 48% -> +$0.80, 52% -> +$9.20, 55% -> +$15.50. Oddsy: the 'Valor esperado y Kelly' form shows EV% only (no $ EV, break-even, edge, fair-odds input or table).

calculators.name: Kelly Criterion Calculator (/betting-calculators/kelly-criterion/)
inputs: Kelly multiplier: Quarter (default) | Half | Three-quarter | Full | Custom
outputs: Sensitivity table: win estimate -5, -2, 0, +2, +5 pp with bankroll % and stake
formulas: Full Kelly f = (p * d - 1) / (d - 1), set to 0 if negative
calculators.worked_example: $1,000 bankroll, +100 (d = 2.00), 55%: f = (0.55*2 - 1)/(2 - 1) = 10% -> $100 full; quarter Kelly = $25 (2.5% of bankroll), EV 10%, break-even 50%. Table: 50% -> $0, 53% -> $15, 57% -> $35, 60% -> $50. Oddsy: betmath.kelly matches exactly (with fraction and bankroll); only the break-even and table are missing.

calculators.name: Arbitrage & Hedge Calculator (/betting-calculators/arbitrage-hedge/)
inputs: Stake mode: Allocate a total budget | Hedge an existing bet
Total budget B (budget mode) or existing stake s1 (hedge mode)
Outcome 2 odds d2 (two-way only; no draw)
outputs: Minimum net profit (lower of the two outcomes after cent rounding)
Table: payout and net profit if each outcome wins
formulas: Budget split: s1 = B * d2 / (d1 + d2); s2 = B - s1
Profit if 1 wins = s1*d1 - s1 - s2
Profit if 2 wins = s2*d2 - s1 - s2
Stakes rounded to cents before profits; headline = min of both; return = min profit / (s1 + s2)
calculators.worked_example: $100 budget, +110 on both sides: stakes $50/$50, either winner returns $105, so +$5 (5%). At -110/-110 the same split loses about $4.55. Hedge mode: $100 already on +150 (2.50), hedge at -200 (1.50) needs 100*2.5/1.5 = $166.67, locking -$16.67 either way. Oddsy: betmath.arbitrage does the N-way budget split and the Arb tab uses it for scanned arbs, but there is no manual calculator, no hedge-existing-bet mode and no cent rounding/min-profit view.

calculators.name: Bonus Bet Conversion Calculator (/betting-calculators/bonus-bet-conversion/)
inputs: Bonus type: Stake not returned (standard) | Stake returned as cash
outputs: Converted cash profit (lower of the two cases)
Table: net cash profit if bonus wins / if hedge wins
formulas: Bonus payout = B * (d - 1) (stake not returned); = B * d (stake returned)
Profit if bonus wins = bonus payout - H
Conversion rate = min(both profits, after rounding) / B
calculators.worked_example: $100 standard bonus at +300 (d = 4.00) hedged at -300 (h = 1.3333): bonus would pay $300, hedge stake = 300/1.3333 = $225; bonus wins -> 300 - 225 = $75; hedge wins -> 225*0.3333 = $75; conversion 75%. Oddsy: none.

calculators.name: Odds Converter (/betting-calculators/odds-converter/)
inputs: Input format: American | Decimal | Fractional (n/m with slash, positive only)
calculators.worked_example: +150 = 2.50 = 3/2. A winning $100 nets $150 and returns $250; break-even 1/2.5 = 40%. -110 -> 1.9091 -> 10/11. Oddsy: 'Conversor de cuotas' does decimal<->American, fractional output (denominator capped at 100) and implied prob, but has no fractional input and no stake/profit/payout.

calculators.name: Implied Probability Calculator (/betting-calculators/implied-probability/)
calculators.worked_example: -110: p = 110/210 = 52.38%; an estimate of 55% is +2.62 pp over it; a $100 win nets $90.91 and returns $190.91 (d = 1.9091, 10/11). Oddsy: implied prob only appears as a line in the converter; no estimate/edge input.

calculators.name: No-Vig Fair Odds Calculator (/betting-calculators/no-vig-fair-odds/)
outputs: Table per outcome: implied chance, no-vig chance, fair American, margin (pp)
calculators.worked_example: -110/-110: each q = 52.38%, S = 104.76%, so each p = 50% -> fair +100; overround 4.76%, each side carries +2.38 pp of margin. Oddsy: 'Cuota justa sin margen' does the same proportional method for any number of outcomes (fair decimal + %, margin); only fair American and per-outcome margin pp are missing.

calculators.name: Hold Calculator (/betting-calculators/hold/)
outputs: Table per outcome: implied, no-vig, fair American, margin pp
calculators.worked_example: +120 / -125: q = 45.45% and 55.56%, S = 101.01%, overround 1.01%, hold 0.0101/1.0101 = 1.00%; fair odds +122 / -122. Reference: -110/-110 gives overround 4.76% and hold 4.55%. Oddsy: overround shows as 'Margen de la casa' inside the no-vig form; theoretical hold (S-1)/S is not computed.

calculators.name: Vig Calculator (/betting-calculators/vig/)
outputs: Estimated cost of vig ($) for the selected bet
Table: implied, no-vig, fair American, margin pp per outcome
formulas: q_i = 1/d_i; S = sum q_i; p_i = q_i / S
Vig cost = stake * (1 - p_sel * d_sel) (negative = favorable price)
calculators.worked_example: -110/-110, $100 on side 1: fair p = 50%; a win nets $90.91, a loss costs $100; EV = 0.5*90.91 - 0.5*100 = -$4.55, so vig cost $4.55 (overround 4.76%, hold 4.55%). Oddsy: no dollar vig cost; only the overround in the no-vig form.

calculators.name: Prediction Markets Converter (/betting-calculators/prediction-markets/)
inputs: Convert from: Contract price (cents) | Betting odds
outputs: American, decimal, fractional odds (gross, before fees)
formulas: Implied p = c / 100; decimal = 100 / c (odds mode: c = 100 / d)
calculators.worked_example: 65 cents -> 65% -> 1.5385 decimal, -186 American, 7/13; 100 contracts cost $65 with no fee, settle to $100, so +$35; complement 35 cents. With a 2 cent fee: cost $67, profit $33, break-even 67%. Oddsy: none.

calculators.name: Half Point Calculator (/betting-calculators/half-point/)
inputs: Selected side: Team spread | Total Over | Total Under
Whole-number baseline: probability of a push at that number q (%)
Half-point baseline: probability of landing on each neighbouring whole number
outputs: Table for lower/baseline/higher line: win %, push %, selected fair odds, opposite fair odds
formulas: Whole baseline: win = p*(1 - q), push = q, loss = (1 - p)*(1 - q)
Half-point move toward you (higher spread/under line, lower over line): the push number becomes a win -> win = p*(1-q) + q, push 0
Half-point move against you: the push number becomes a loss -> win = p*(1-q), push 0

Half baseline (derived the same way; exact client code not fetched): moving toward you turns the adjacent losing number m into a push (win = p, push = m); moving against you turns the adjacent winning number m' into a push (win = p - m', push = m')
Fair decimal = (1 - push) / win; opposite side uses its own win = loss of selected
calculators.worked_example: Team -3, -110 both sides, 8% chance of exactly 3: p = 0.5, so at -3 win 46%, push 8%, loss 46% -> fair (0.92/0.46) = 2.00 = +100. At -2.5 the 3 becomes a win: 54% -> about -117. At -3.5 it becomes a loss: 46% -> about +117 (opposite side -117). Oddsy: none.

calculators.name: Point Spread Calculator (/betting-calculators/point-spread/)
inputs: League context: NFL | NBA | College football | College basketball | Custom (only presets sigma; example values, not fitted; NFL = 13.5)
outputs: Sensitivity table at sigma*0.8, sigma, sigma*1.2
formulas: Fair decimal = 1 / P; convert to American (d>=2: +(d-1)*100; d<2: -100/(d-1))
calculators.worked_example: -3 spread, sigma 13.5: mu = 3, z = 3/13.5 = 0.2222, Phi(z) = 58.79% -> fair -143; opponent 41.21% -> +143. Sigma 10.8 gives 60.94% (-156), 16.2 gives 57.35% (-134). Oddsy: none (needs a normal CDF / erf helper).

calculators.name: Poisson Calculator (/betting-calculators/poisson/)
inputs: Expected average count lambda (0 to 200, same period as the bet)
Probability mode: Exact / at least / at most | Over/under a betting line
Event count k (whole, 0 to 1000) or betting line (whole or .5)
outputs: Exact-mode: P(exactly k), P(at least k), P(at most k), fair American for each
Over/under mode: win, loss, push chances and fair odds for over and under
formulas: Over line L: half line -> win = P(X >= ceil(L)); whole line -> win = P(X > L), push = P(X = L), under win = P(X < L)
calculators.worked_example: lambda = 2.5, k = 3: exactly 3 = e^-2.5 * 2.5^3 / 6 = 21.38% (+368), at least 3 = 45.62% (+119), at most 3 = 75.76% (-313). Over 2.5 needs 3 or more, so it also wins 45.62% of the time. Oddsy: none.
